svg.title: Twin Rings: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: Two cliff rings with staggered gates. The outer gate faces your base, the inner gates face the gaps, so every road to the hill turns along the ring corridor and meets a neighbour on the way. Bots can climb the inner ring straight from their gate; vehicles can't.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 18 × 18 map (9216 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
Two cliff rings with staggered gates. The outer gate faces your base, the inner gates face the gaps,
so every road to the hill turns along the ring corridor and meets a neighbour on the way. Bots can
climb the inner ring straight from their gate; vehicles can't.
Heights: outer ground 220 · corridor 280 · inside the inner ring 340 · the hill 380
Ground: violet dust plains, lilac crystal sand inside the rings, dark purple glassy rock in the ring
cliffs, pale roads of crushed crystal.
Plants: orangemushrooms in glowing fungal groves, the only life; no trees.
Features: pilha_crystal_violet and pilha_crystal_teal along the ring cliffs, large
pilha_crystal_team3 at the gates, pilha_crystal1 scattered across the plains.
Sky and weather: lilac sky, violet haze; wind 4 to 14; tidal 0.
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
